plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Geology, AS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/geology-as/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Geology Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The schedule grid names no footnote definitions on this page; unnamed slots are modeled as choice slots with an honest 'not defined on this page; see advisor' note. The published grid presents the physics sequence as alternatives separated by blank rows: PHYS 151 or (PHYS 180 & 180L) in the 3rd semester, PHYS 152 or (PHYS 181 & 181L) in the 4th — modeled as OR choice slots; taking the PHYS 180/181 path includes the 1-unit lab. MATH 181 and MATH 182 are required of Geology majors at UNR prior to graduation. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
